description: This file is a Java source class named PropFindHelper, which provides helper methods for handling WebDAV PROPFIND HTTP requests and responses within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PropFindHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing WebDAV PROPFIND requests, including building XML elements and parsing request documents.

methods.name: PropFindHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a request XML document.

methods.name: createPropElement
methods.description: Creates a 'prop' XML element, appending a list of property elements if provided.

methods.name: createPropStatElement
methods.description: Creates a 'propstat' XML element containing a property element and its status.

methods.name: getFindPropsList
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of property elements from the request document for a given namespace.

methods.name: isAllProp
methods.description: Checks if the request document contains an 'allprop' element.

methods.name: isPropName
methods.description: Checks if the request document contains a 'propname' element.
